name: fungus-games
description: Two mobile games: Humongous Fungus (idle terrarium) and Sporeggar (mushroom market trading).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && GAME=fungus vite build && GAME=sporeggar vite build
scripts.build:artifact: npm run build && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs fungus && node scripts/make-artifact.mjs sporeggar
